BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

4. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.

5. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceilings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceilings.

6. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.

7. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.

8. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.

9. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

11. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

12. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Wall Finishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Floor Finishes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Ceilings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Fixings and Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. B — Information and Communication Technology

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.

6. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

10. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

12. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Wall Finishes; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fixings and Fittings; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
